text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ruka had no choice but to acknowledge both her love for {0} and her special bond with him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}への恋心と、
{0}との特別な縁。
その両方を認めざるを得なくなったルカ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: While Ruka is confused by her wavering heart, a new crisis is looming for the "Boss Lady Gang".
text_block_list.orig_text:
揺れる心に戸惑うルカをよそに、
姉御会には新たな危機が迫っていた。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: An ambush, you say?
text_block_list.orig_text: カチコミだって？

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Huh! Some guys called the "Goldfish Gang" are trying to get us to join under their umbrella group... They're almost here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ！　
『金魚会』って連中が、
うちを傘下に入れようと迫ってきて……
もうすぐそこまで来てます！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I wonder what the purpose of trying to obtain a boring gang like ours even is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちみたいな旨味のない団体に、
なんの目的だい。

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: They've been putting a lot of pressure on us lately. They're trying to get us under their umbrella so that they can increase the number of hands at their disposal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここ最近
圧力をかけてきてたんですよ。
うちを傘下にして
体のいい小間使いを増やそうって魂胆です。

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: They are troublesome people connected to guilds and nobles who make money through shady business. Even if they do something bad and get caught, they run away right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あくどい商売で儲けるギルドや
貴族どもとつながってる厄介な連中です。
悪さしてつかまっても
すぐに逃げやがる。

text_block_list.name: Underling 3
text_block_list.text: Boss Lady, it's dangerous to remain here! We'll hold them off for now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御、
ここも危ないっす！
いったんワシらが食い止めるんで──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Wait... {0}, you're back here again even today?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って
お前さんは今日もいるのかい！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: ...Heh heh. When Lil'bro's around, we also get in a better mood. To be honest, we love him. We'd love for him to be around every day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へへ。
アニキがいると、
ワシらも
テンション上がるっていうか。
ぶっちゃけ、
大好き。
毎日呼んでる。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see... Th-That's fine and all, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ
そう……
そ、
それはいいが……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: There's no way we'll give in to those rascals. I'll take care of this. Everyone, stand back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな不埒なヤツらに
打ちなびくわけにゃいかないね。
ここはアタシが片付ける。
みんな、
下がってな！

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: But, Boss Lady going by yourself is---
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
姉御一人じゃ──

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: There she is! It's their leader, Ruka!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたぞ！　
頭領のルカだ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...It seems they've arrived.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……お見えだね。

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Well, well, the general herself is here to greet us, so that's a quick end to the matter. All you have to do is bow down your head, and the negotiations will be over. You'll be under our umbrella, won't you, "Boss Lady"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはこれは、
大将自らお出迎えとは話が早い。
あなたが首を縦にふりさえすれば
交渉は終わりです。
うちの傘下に
入りますよね？　
姉御さん。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I refuse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪いが、
断るよ。

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: Wha!? An immediate answer!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！？　
即答ぉお！？

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: You know that if you're going to stand in our way, you're basically saying that you want your entire Gang dismantled and destroyed, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちに盾突くということは、
「会ごとお取り潰しにしてください」という意思表示だってことは、
ご存じですよね？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I don't really care how you're planning on interpreting my words. At the end of the day, we're just a group of misfits that doesn't even have a stable income just yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう受け取ってもらおうが、
構やしないさ。
確かにうちは、
シノギもろくにねえ与太団体だからね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: However, unlike the rotten underhanded dealings you guys employ, we don't allow any of our members to live a life where they can't face the sun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただね。
お宅らが担いでる腐れ神輿と違って、
うちは会員の誰一人にも、
お天道様に顔向けできない生き方はさせちゃいない。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of degrading my Gang into your goldfish poop.
text_block_list.orig_text: 金魚のフンに成り下がる気はないんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: What was that?! Pickin' a fight?!
text_block_list.orig_text: んだとやるかぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Heh... So you want me to draw my sword? You guys sure can't count your chances well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
アタシに刀を抜かせる気かい？
計算のできないフンどもだねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: I wonder who's the one bad at counting here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
計算ができないのは、
どっちでしょうねえ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: …Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ああ？

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: That cloaked young man over there.
text_block_list.orig_text: そこのマントの僕ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you. I heard you're on very good terms with the royal palace. Beyond that, I heard you're also on good terms with the Guild Management Association? You have a warm and friendly demeanor, and seem to be quite an important figure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ僕です。
聞けば僕ちゃん、
ずいぶんと王宮と仲良しだそうですねぇ。
その上、
ギルド管理協会ともねんごろだとか？
ほんわかしたナリで、
なかなかどーして一角の人物らしい。

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Well you see, our underhanded dealings run quite deep. It'd be a piece of cake to crush the arms and legs of any of your friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやね、
うちの腐れ神輿ってのが意外と重い神輿なもので。
僕ちゃんの仲良しさんたちの手足を潰すくらいのことは、
朝飯前なんですよ。

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm also aware that you are well-trusted around town. But wouldn't it be a problem if bad rumors were to spread about you? And how about your employers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
信頼が厚いのはもちろん知ってますけどねえ。
悪いうわさが立ったら困るんじゃないですかね、
僕ちゃんの取引先さんもねえ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...! Using such dirty tricks is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
汚い手を使いやがって……

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you've finally figured out what's going on here. That's right. If you draw your sword, he'll be the one in trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほほう、
やっと計算がおいつきましたか。
そ
うです。
あなたが刀を抜けば、
困るのはこの僕ちゃんです。

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: I’ll ask you one more time, okay? Would you rather join us without drawing your sword, or draw your sword and cause trouble for that young man? FI-NAL-AN-SWER.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一度だけ、
聞きますよ？
刀を抜かずに傘下に入るか、
刀を抜いて僕ちゃんを困らせるか。
ふぁい、
なる、
あん、
さー

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……くっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Neither I nor these underlings of mine have anything to lose. Especially my guild, which is made up of lone wolves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシにも
この舎弟たちにも、
失うものなんてありゃしない。
まして
みんな一匹狼の
アタシのギルドも、
だ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: However... this young man...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど。
この子は……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I know. {0}, you're you. And I am me. Until now, I would have just accepted that answer and thrown away my sheath.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ、
分かってるよ。
お前さんはお前さん。
アタシはアタシ。
今までなら、
そう割り切って
鞘、
ぶん投げてきたさ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: But... right now... Right now, I... I can't accept endangering you so easily...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど……
今は……
今の、
アタシは……
そんなに簡単に
割り切れない──

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: I see an opening. GO NOW!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スキができました。
今です。

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: RIGHT!!
text_block_list.orig_text: うをっす！！

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: GWAAAAAAH! BOSS LAAAADYYYY!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁぁぁぁ！　
姉御ッ！

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: All right. That's everyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし。
これで全員だな。

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, why did you even bother to grab me?! You even handcuffed me! If you're going to crush me, why don't you just get it done already?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
なんでひっとらえる！　
手錠なんてかけやがって！
潰すなら、
さっさとタマをとりゃいいだろうが！

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. That was merely a cover-up. It'd be a pain if we were to stand out by doing pointless gang fights.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません。
あれは方便です。
無駄なドンパチなんかして目立つと面倒なので。

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Now, let's wrap this up in one fell swoop♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
こいつで
一気に仕舞いを付けましょう♪

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: What's with that stamp-like thing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだい、
そのハンコみたいなモンは。

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: Heheheh. It's a goldfish stamp that will never disappear, once I press it you'll be one of us. It's a sign that you are under the umbrella of the Goldfish Gang.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっへっへ。
いったん押したら最後、
一生消えない金魚印の墨スタンプだ。
金魚会の傘下に入ったという印だよ。

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: If we leave this mark on you, your public image will be forever gone. You won't be able to live a normal life anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつを押されりゃ、
世間の目が変わる。
もう普通には生きられん。

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: If you'd just listened quietly from the start, you could've saved yourself by having just your arms or butts stamped. But now you're all getting stamps on your foreheads!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
最初から大人しく言うことを聞いていたら、
ワシらみたいに、
ほれ、
腕や尻で済んだのにねぇ。
お前らは全員、
デコにスタンプだ！

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: A-A stamp?! And we can't hide it?! They'll be able to see it on our forehead! Anytime!
text_block_list.orig_text:
デ、
デコォ！？
隠せないじゃねぇか！？
いつでもどこでも丸見えじゃねぇかぁ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: These... dirty goldfish...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この……
汚れ金魚どもが……！

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: *cackle* You're barking. A fake Samurai who couldn't even draw her sword to protect her man's honor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっくっく、
吠えますねぇ。
男のために刀を抜けなかった、
エセザムライが。

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's start from their Boss Lady. Get that cute little forehead in here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
姉御さんからです。
そのかわいいおデコを出してもらいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh! ...Hm? I-It's so bright...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……くっ！
……うん？　
ま、
眩しい……！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it's more crowded than I expected.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……しかし
思った以上の混み具合だね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, {0}. I brought you to this super bathhouse as a thank you for helping me with the fishmonger's big sale, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまないね、
お前さん。
魚屋の大売り出し、
手伝ってくれたお礼に
スーパー銭湯に
連れてきたはいいものの。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I didn't know they were only doing mixed bathing in the middle of renovations. I even ended up having to rent swimsuits...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
改装中で、
混浴しかやってないなんて
知らなくてさ。
レンタル水着なんか
着せちまって……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: R-Really? I didn't expect you to be so forthcoming...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうかい？
意外と
キモが据わってんだね……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I have to be careful here... Standing in a crowded mixed bath together with a minor like you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシは気を遣うよ……
未成年のお前さんと、
こんな
ギュウギュウの混浴風呂なんて……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: At the very least, we're back-to-back... I'm glad I can turn my body away, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
せめて
背中合わせで
って……
体、
背けたはいいけど……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: At this very moment, our bare backs are pressed together... Ahh, somehow, I'm starting to feel hot...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は
背中と背中が密着しちまって……
ああ、
なんだか
のぼせてきたよ……

text_block_list.name: 流夏
text_block_list.text:
だ、
黙ってるからだめなんだ。
こういう時は、
そうだ、
色気とは無縁の、
アイツらの話題を……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
黙ってるからだめなんだ。
こういう時は、
そうだ、
色気とは無縁の、
アイツらの話題を……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, listen to this, {0}. Recently, the number of people calling themselves my underlings has been increasing. Everywhere I go, they follow me around as if it's a feudal lord's procession.
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
聞いとくれよお前さん。
最近、
自称舎弟を名乗る輩が、
ますます増えちまってね。
どこに行くにも、
大名行列みたいについてきやがるのさ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Right? Even when I didn't ask them to, they still tried to attract in customers. However with such scary and dangerous looks on their faces, all they've done is achieve the opposite.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だろう？　
頼んでもないのに呼び込みなんかしやがって。
あんな物騒な面構えに
店先でがなられちゃ、
営業妨害にしかなりゃしないよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Good good... I'm getting cooled down from my steamy feelings. Phew... this is the first time I'm feeling grateful to that bunch for being a good distraction topic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしよし……
いい感じにクールダウンだ。
ふぅ……
はじめてアイツらに感謝するよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……うん？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Huh...? You think my charm is that I act only according to my own beliefs, without being trapped by prejudice or self-preservation...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
偏見や
保身に囚われることなく、
自分の信念だけに従って
行動するところが、
アタシの、
魅力……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: From your point of view, I'm beautiful... You think it's natural that I'd be admired...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
僕から見ても素敵……
慕われて
当然……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hey, {0}...! Don't j-just praise me w-without warning!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──って、
お前さん！
前触れもなく
人のこと、
ほ、
褒めるんじゃないよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Even though... I've brought up those people as an argument to try and calm myself down...
text_block_list.orig_text:
人が……
必死に気持ち落ち着けようとしてるってのに……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ......However. I can't believe you looked at me like that......
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………でも。
アタシのこと、
そんなふうに
見てくれてたなんて……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Well, it seems "cooling down" is just a pipe dream now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こりゃ、
クールダウンは、
無理だね……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Okay, good work today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
お疲れちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: It must be nice when someone notices and compliments your charms that you don't even realize yourself. I think you did a good job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分でも気付けていない魅力に、
誰かが気付いて褒めてくれるって、
そりゃうれしいわよね。
あんたにしちゃいいことしたと思うわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, that's also where all problems start...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど。
問題はここからよね～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Just think about it. Knowing your own charms can of course give you confidence, but on the flip side, it can also be a curse that binds you. It's a double-edged sword.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって考えてもみなさいよ。
自分の魅力を知るってことは、
もちろん自信にもなるけど、
裏を返せば我が身を縛る呪いにもなる、
諸刃の剣よ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Huh? You wonder what I mean by a charm becoming a curse? Hmm... It'd be a pain to explain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
魅力が呪いになるって
どういうことかって？
うーん……
説明が面倒ね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Watch over Ruka after this. I'm sure you'll understand then. And you should learn together with her as a lesson. This is your punishment for giving someone praise so carelessly. Just kidding♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
この後のルカを見守ってなさい。
きっと分かるはずよ。
そしてあんたも一緒に学びなさい。
軽々しく人を褒めた罰よ。
な～んてね♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: See you later~
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあね～

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! Was that... a daydream...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はっ！
今のは……
白昼夢……？

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: "Boss Lady", y'see... this isn't really the time to be spacing out, is it? Now, put some energy into your forehead. Here we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御さん、
ボーっとしてる場合じゃないですよ？
さぁ、
おデコに気合を入れて。
ポンといきますよー！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Beliefs... Not being trapped by prejudice or self-preservation...
text_block_list.orig_text:
信念……
偏見や……
保身に、
囚われることのない……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's my...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが、
アタシの……

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Oryo? Did you reject the stamp? So you don't care what happens to this young man?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おりょりょ？　
ハンコを撥ね退けましたか。
男がどうなってもいいと？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: As long as I don't draw my sword, you won't put any kind of pressure on this young man. That's what you said, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシが刀さえ抜かなけりゃ、
この子に圧力はかけない。
そう言ったね？

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Yes, I did say that. Maybe you hate to be reminded this, but if you don't draw your sword, you're merely just a woman...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
言いましたよ？　
こう言ってはなんだが、
刀を抜かなければ、
あなたなんてただの女──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Who's... "just a woman"?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰が……
ただの
女だって！？

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: Whoa! She broke the cuffs with her sheathed katana...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ！
手錠を、
鞘に入れたままの刀で、
砕いた……！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Just so you're aware. The only one here who's "just a sword" is my katana...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言っとくけどね。
ただの武器なのは、
刀の方さ……！

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: Gyah! This time, she smashed the goldfish sta--
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃっ！
今度は金魚スタンプを、
叩き割っ──！

text_block_list.name: Members of the Goldfish Gang
text_block_list.text: Wow! She cut all the stamps in half?! Such a small thing... with a sword still in its sheath, without an inch of deviation... This woman... is crazy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁぁ！　
全てのスタンプを真っ二つに！？
こんな小せぇモンを……
鞘に入ったままの刀で寸分の狂いもなく……
この女……
ヤベェっすよ！

text_block_list.name: Goldfish Gang Executive
text_block_list.text: G-Grrrrrrr! Retreat for now! RETREAAAAAAAAAT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ、
ぐぬぬぬぬぅ！
いったん撤退！　
撤退ー！

text_block_list.name: Underling 2
text_block_list.text: Wow, you really are amazing! You defeated the enemy without even drawing your sword, and protected both the "Boss Lady Gang" and Lil'bro right here perfectly. Boss Lady you truly are an inspiring leader!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー
さすがでしたね！　
刀を抜かずして敵を破り、
姉御会もアニキのことも、
きっちり守り切りよった。
さすが我らが頭領、
姉御ですわ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I'll be out for a bit. Sorry {0}, but I'd like to ask you to help with the clean-up here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょいと、
出てくるよ。
すまないがお前さん、
ここの後片付け、
手伝ってやっとくれ。

text_block_list.name: Underling 1
text_block_list.text: Boss Lady...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 姉御……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I... couldn't pull it out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
抜け……
なかった……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That right there was a moment where I should've unsheated it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
抜くべき場面、
だったのに。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I wield my sword only according to my own beliefs. That is my way of life. That is the justice to which I've lived by...
text_block_list.orig_text:
己の信念のみに従い、
刀を振るう。
それが、
アタシの生き方だ。
これまでもそうやって、
仁義を通してきたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: And yet, I couldn't do it. I chose not to let a shadow fall on that young man's smile over my own righteousness...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なのに、
できなかった。
仁義より、
あの子の笑顔に
陰りを作らないことの方を、
選んだ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I can no longer swing my sword freely...? Because I fell in love...? No way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自由に、
刀を振れなくなった……？
恋をした、せいで……？
まさか、
そんな。

text_block_list.name: ルカ
text_block_list.text:
こんなのは、
アタシじゃない……
サムライじゃない……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなのは、
アタシじゃない……
サムライじゃない……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...But, to think that I would take the plunge and think about that young man... It's too late now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
あの子のことを、
思い切るなんて……
今更、
そんなこと……

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Um, are you okay? Are you feeling okay...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
大丈夫ですか？
具合でも……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, please tell me... What kind of face am I making right now...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なぁ、
教えておくれよ……
アタシは今、
どんな顔をしてる……？

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: E-Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I don't know myself... Please...
text_block_list.orig_text:
分からないんだ……
頼むよ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Despite being a samurai, Ruka had fallen in love with {0}. No matter how much she asked, she could not grasp the outline of her lost self.
text_block_list.orig_text:
サムライでありながら恋をしてしまったルカ。
見失ってしまった自分の輪郭は、
問いかけても問いかけても、掴めないのであった。
